name: PNB RuPay Platinum Vishwas & Varishth Debit Card
description: PNB RuPay Platinum Vishwas & Varishth Debit Card is a PNB RUPAY PLATINUM VISHWAS & VARISHTH from Punjab National Bank. International usage; ATM limit Rs. 50,000/day, PoS/eCom limit Rs. 150,000/day. NCMC offline transit enabled. Valid 7 years.
tagline: RuPay Platinum debit card from PNB — international usage with NCMC transit.
